exposure: Device-measured blood loss (using a mobile application that photographs sponges and canisters and calculates their hemoglobin content)
outcome: Number of red cell units transfused
cohort: 2,781 women undergoing cesarean deliveries (2,025 in the visual estimation group and 756 in the device group)
finding: Using a device to measure blood loss during cesarean delivery identified hemorrhages more frequently than visual estimation, potentially leading to earlier recognition and treatment and reduced blood product transfusion.
